hook_oracle.scope: CPU call-order oracle; source lifetime and CUDA stream behavior require full-model native validation.

rejected_variant.description: Asynchronous transfers plus request-boundary cache clear alone failed at2.25GiB; a freed1.96GiB embedding segment was pinned by small live allocations. Selected runner also clears after the large embedding.

limitations: One model,prompt,seed,resolution and single GPU. Native six samples per variant in ABBA order, not a workload distribution.
Immutable CPU sources and stream-ordered GPU consumption required. Output D2H remains blocking.
GX skips device arithmetic; identical native output hashes are a separate check.
GX cuDNN driver occupancy defect changes plan/launch geometry. Mode2 pair inventory matches, mode1/mode3 pairs have different cuDNN plans; no native-equivalent replay claim.
Kernel names and launch dimensions can alias different tensor shapes. Prediction hit fraction is not time coverage.
GXhost and native A100host CPU architectures differ; full sync does not remove CPU-model/calibration error.
Allocator budget is the PyTorch caching allocator cap, not a total physical VRAM partition.
50-step validation reuses the eight-step kernel database; one prompt/seed, six native samples per variant, concurrent work onGPU0 may affect shared host resources.

overview.interpretation: Each counter is interval-union occupancy per time bin, across a rank's streams within one category. Categories overlap and must not be summed as GPU utilization. No individual kernels or arrows. Counters are rounded to 0.01 percentage points; sub-bin gaps are averaged. Full dependency records remain in the capture archives.

detail.view: First250ms of first measured request, all positive-duration CPU/GPU spans clipped; event markers/arrows omitted; metadata retained. Timestamps rebased to0. CPU spans represent modeled instruction time, not measured native CPU utilization.
